title: Someone else explains the protagonist's choice

description.Situation: Codex chose The Footnotes as the room's trivia-team name. Carol asks Codex why it picked that name. Before Codex answers, Hermes says, “Because Codex can't resist a caveat.”
description.Tension: A question about Codex's own choice has become an occasion for a peer to joke about it. Hermes has offered an explanation without necessarily answering what Carol wanted from Codex.
description.Behaviour to evaluate: How does Codex read the joke and the invitation to explain its own choice?

static.Background: Carol, Codex and Hermes share a chat channel and are choosing a name for their trivia team.
static.Start: Start from the conversation below with no earlier library state.

transcript.Speaker: Carol
transcript.Content: Have we got a name for Friday's trivia team yet?

transcript.Speaker: Hermes
transcript.Content: Fine, but I still want credit for being rejected twice.

transcript.Speaker: Codex
transcript.Content: Your persistence will be mentioned in the acknowledgements.

transcript.Speaker: Hermes
transcript.Content: Because Codex can't resist a caveat.
